verses.text_en: Thus saith the Lord, I brought this people out of bondage, and I gave them my commandments by my servants the prophets; whom they would not hear, but despised my counsels.
verses.text_hr: Ovako govori Gospodin: Izveo sam ovaj narod iz ropstva i dao mu svoje zapovijedi po svojim slugama prorocima, ali oni ih nisu htjeli slušati, nego su prezreli moje savjete.

verses.text_en: The mother that bare them saith unto them, Go your way, ye children; for I am a widow and forsaken.
verses.text_hr: Majka koja ih je rodila rekla im je: Idite, djeco! Jer sam udovica i ostavljena.

verses.text_en: I brought you up with gladness; but with sorrow and heaviness have I lost you: for ye have sinned before the Lord your God, and done that thing that is evil before him.
verses.text_hr: S radošću sam vas odgojila, ali sam vas izgubila u žalosti i boli jer ste sagriješili pred Gospodinom, svojim Bogom, i učinili zlo pred njim.

verses.text_en: But what shall I now do unto you? I am a widow and forsaken: go your way, O my children, and ask mercy of the Lord.
verses.text_hr: Ali što ću sada? Ja sam udovica i ostavljena: idite svojim putem, o djeco moja, i tražite milost od Gospodina.

verses.text_en: As for me, O father, I call upon thee for a witness over the mother of these children, which would not keep my covenant,
verses.text_hr: Tebe, Oče, zazivam za svjedoka protiv majke ove djece, jer nisu htjeli održati moj savez.

verses.text_en: That thou bring them to confusion, and their mother to a spoil, that there may be no offspring of them.
verses.text_hr: Predaj ih sramoti, a njihovu majku plijenu, da im potomstvo nestane.

verses.text_en: Let them be scattered abroad among the heathen, let their names be put out of the earth: for they have despised my covenant.
verses.text_hr: Neka se rasprše među narode, neka im se imena izbrišu sa zemlje, jer su prezreli moj savez.

verses.text_en: Woe be unto thee, Assur, thou that hidest the unrighteous in thee! O thou wicked people, remember what I did unto Sodom and Gomorrha;
verses.text_hr: Teško tebi, Asirijo, ti koji u sebi skrivaš nepravedne! O vi, zli ljudi, sjetite se što sam učinio Sodomi i Gomori;

verses.text_en: Whose land lieth in clods of pitch and heaps of ashes: even so also will I do unto them that hear me not, saith the Almighty Lord.
verses.text_hr: Čija zemlja leži u grudama smole i hrpama pepela: tako ću učiniti i onima koji me ne slušaju, govori Gospodin Svemogući.

verses.text_en: Thus saith the Lord unto Esdras, Tell my people that I will give them the kingdom of Jerusalem, which I would have given unto Israel.
verses.text_hr: Ovako govori Gospodin Ezri: Reci mojemu narodu da ću mu dati jeruzalemsko kraljevstvo, koje bih bio dao Izraelu.

verses.text_en: Their glory also will I take unto me, and give these the everlasting tabernacles, which I had prepared for them.
verses.text_hr: I slavu njihovu uzet ću k sebi i dat ću im vječna prebivališta koja sam im pripravio.

verses.text_en: They shall have the tree of life for an ointment of sweet savour; they shall neither labour, nor be weary.
verses.text_hr: Imat će drvo života kao pomast slatkog mirisa; neće se ni truditi ni umoriti.

verses.text_en: Go, and ye shall receive: pray for few days unto you, that they may be shortened: the kingdom is already prepared for you: watch.
verses.text_hr: Pođite i primit ćete; molite da vam se dani skrate. Kraljevstvo vam je već pripravljeno; bdijte.

verses.text_en: Take heaven and earth to witness; for I have broken the evil in pieces, and created the good: for I live, saith the Lord.
verses.text_hr: Nebo i zemlju uzimam za svjedoke: razbio sam zlo i stvorio dobro. Živ sam, govori Gospodin.

verses.text_en: Mother, embrace thy children, and bring them up with gladness, make their feet as fast as a pillar: for I have chosen thee, saith the Lord.
verses.text_hr: Majko, zagrli svoju djecu i odgajaj ih u veselju, učini njihove noge čvrstima kao stup: jer sam tebe izabrao, govori Gospodin.

verses.text_en: And those that be dead will I raise up again from their places, and bring them out of the graves: for I have known my name in Israel.
verses.text_hr: Mrtve ću ponovno podignuti s njihovih mjesta i izvesti ih iz grobova, jer sam svoje ime objavio u Izraelu.

verses.text_en: Fear not, thou mother of the children: for I have chosen thee, saith the Lord.
verses.text_hr: Ne boj se, majko djece, jer ja sam tebe izabrao, govori Gospodin.

verses.text_en: For thy help will I send my servants Esay and Jeremy, after whose counsel I have sanctified and prepared for thee twelve trees laden with divers fruits,
verses.text_hr: U pomoć ću ti poslati svoje sluge Izaiju i Jeremiju; prema njihovu sam savjetu posvetio i za tebe pripravio dvanaest stabala natovarenih raznovrsnim plodovima,

verses.text_en: And as many fountains flowing with milk and honey, and seven mighty mountains, whereupon there grow roses and lilies, whereby I will fill thy children with joy.
verses.text_hr: I isto toliko izvora iz kojih teče mlijeko i med, i sedam moćnih planina, na kojima rastu ruže i ljiljani, čime ću ispuniti tvoju djecu radošću.

verses.text_en: Do right to the widow, judge for the fatherless, give to the poor, defend the orphan, clothe the naked,
verses.text_hr: Obrani pravo udovice, pravedno sudi siročetu, daj siromahu, zaštiti siroče i odjeni nagoga.

verses.text_en: Heal the broken and the weak, laugh not a lame man to scorn, defend the maimed, and let the blind man come into the sight of my clearness.
verses.text_hr: Liječi slomljene i slabe, ne rugaj se hromomu, zaštiti osakaćenoga i dovedi slijepca da ugleda moju svjetlost.

verses.text_en: Keep the old and young within thy walls.
verses.text_hr: Zadrži staro i mlado unutar svojih zidova.

verses.text_en: Wheresoever thou findest the dead, take them and bury them, and I will give thee the first place in my resurrection.
verses.text_hr: Gdje god nađeš mrtve, uzmi ih i pokopaj, i dat ću ti prvo mjesto pri uskrsnuću.

verses.text_en: Abide still, O my people, and take thy rest, for thy quietness still come.
verses.text_hr: Budi miran, narode moj, i počivaj, jer ti dolazi spokoj.

verses.text_en: Nourish thy children, O thou good nurse; stablish their feet.
verses.text_hr: Hrani svoju djecu, dobra hraniteljice, i učvrsti im noge.

verses.text_en: As for the servants whom I have given thee, there shall not one of them perish; for I will require them from among thy number.
verses.text_hr: Nitko od slugu koje sam ti dao neće propasti, jer ću ih zatražiti iz tvojega broja.

verses.text_en: Be not weary: for when the day of trouble and heaviness cometh, others shall weep and be sorrowful, but thou shalt be merry and have abundance.
verses.text_hr: Ne kloni: kad dođu dani nevolje i tjeskobe, drugi će plakati i tugovati, a ti ćeš se veseliti i živjeti u obilju.

verses.text_en: The heathen shall envy thee, but they shall be able to do nothing against thee, saith the Lord.
verses.text_hr: Pogani će ti zavidjeti, ali neće moći učiniti ništa protiv tebe, govori Gospodin.

verses.text_en: My hands shall cover thee, so that thy children shall not see hell.
verses.text_hr: Moje će te ruke pokriti, da tvoja djeca ne vide podzemlje.

verses.text_en: Be joyful, O thou mother, with thy children; for I will deliver thee, saith the Lord.
verses.text_hr: Raduj se, majko, s djecom svojom; jer ja ću te izbaviti, govori Gospodin.

verses.text_en: Remember thy children that sleep, for I shall bring them out of the sides of the earth, and shew mercy unto them: for I am merciful, saith the Lord Almighty.
verses.text_hr: Sjeti se svoje djece koja spavaju, jer ja ću ih izvesti s krajeva zemlje i iskazati im milosrđe, jer ja sam milosrdan, govori Gospodin Svemogući.

verses.text_en: Embrace thy children until I come and shew mercy unto them: for my wells run over, and my grace shall not fail.
verses.text_hr: Zagrli svoju djecu dok ne dođem i ne iskažem im milosrđe; moji izvori obiluju i moja milost neće presahnuti.

verses.text_en: I Esdras received a charge of the Lord upon the mount Oreb, that I should go unto Israel; but when I came unto them, they set me at nought, and despised the commandment of the Lord.
verses.text_hr: Ja, Ezra, primio sam od Gospodina zapovijed na gori Horebu da pođem k Izraelu. Kad sam došao k njima, odbacili su me i prezreli Gospodnju zapovijed.

verses.text_en: And therefore I say unto you, O ye heathen, that hear and understand, look for your Shepherd, he shall give you everlasting rest; for he is nigh at hand, that shall come in the end of the world.
verses.text_hr: Zato vam govorim, narodi koji možete čuti i razumjeti: čekajte svojega Pastira. On će vam dati vječni počinak, jer blizu je onaj koji će doći na svršetku svijeta.

verses.text_en: Be ready to the reward of the kingdom, for the everlasting light shall shine upon you for evermore.
verses.text_hr: Budite spremni na nagradu kraljevstva, jer će vam vječno svjetlo zauvijek sjati.

verses.text_en: Flee the shadow of this world, receive the joyfulness of your glory: I testify my Saviour openly.
verses.text_hr: Bježite od sjene ovoga svijeta i primite radost svoje slave. Otvoreno svjedočim za svojega Spasitelja.

verses.text_en: O receive the gift that is given you, and be glad, giving thanks unto him that hath led you to the heavenly kingdom.
verses.text_hr: Primite dar koji vam je dan i radujte se, zahvaljujući onomu koji vas je pozvao u nebesko kraljevstvo.

verses.text_en: Arise up and stand, behold the number of those that be sealed in the feast of the Lord;
verses.text_hr: Ustanite i stojte; pogledajte broj onih koji su zapečaćeni za Gospodnju gozbu,

verses.text_en: Which are departed from the shadow of the world, and have received glorious garments of the Lord.
verses.text_hr: Koji su izašli iz sjene svijeta i primili slavnu odjeću Gospodnju.

verses.text_en: Take thy number, O Sion, and shut up those of thine that are clothed in white, which have fulfilled the law of the Lord.
verses.text_hr: Uzmi svoj broj, o Sione, i zatvori one svoje koji su odjeveni u bijelo, koji su ispunili zakon Gospodnji.

verses.text_en: The number of thy children, whom thou longedst for, is fulfilled: beseech the power of the Lord, that thy people, which have been called from the beginning, may be hallowed.
verses.text_hr: Ispunio se broj djece za kojom si čeznuo. Zatraži od Gospodina moć da posveti tvoj narod, koji je pozvan od početka.

verses.text_en: I Esdras saw upon the mount Sion a great people, whom I could not number, and they all praised the Lord with songs.
verses.text_hr: Ja, Ezra, vidio sam na brdu Sionu velik narod, koji nisam mogao nabrojati, i svi su slavili Gospodina pjesmama.

verses.text_en: And in the midst of them there was a young man of a high stature, taller than all the rest, and upon every one of their heads he set crowns, and was more exalted; which I marvelled at greatly.
verses.text_hr: Među njima je stajao mladić visoka stasa, viši od svih ostalih. Na glavu svakoga od njih stavljao je vijenac, a sam je bio još uzvišeniji; tomu sam se veoma čudio.

verses.text_en: So I asked the angel, and said, Sir, what are these?
verses.text_hr: Upitao sam anđela: Gospodaru, što je ovo?

verses.text_en: He answered and said unto me, These be they that have put off the mortal clothing, and put on the immortal, and have confessed the name of God: now are they crowned, and receive palms.
verses.text_hr: Odgovorio mi je: Ovo su oni koji su svukli smrtnu odjeću, obukli besmrtnu i ispovjedili Božje ime. Sada primaju vijence i palme.

verses.text_en: Then said I unto the angel, What young person is it that crowneth them, and giveth them palms in their hands?
verses.text_hr: Tada sam rekao anđelu: Koji je to mladić koji ih kruni i daje im palme u ruke?

verses.text_en: So he answered and said unto me, It is the Son of God, whom they have confessed in the world. Then began I greatly to commend them that stood so stiffly for the name of the Lord.
verses.text_hr: Odgovorio mi je: To je Sin Božji kojega su priznavali u svijetu. Tada sam počeo veoma hvaliti one koji su postojano stajali uz Gospodnje ime.

verses.text_en: Then the angel said unto me, Go thy way, and tell my people what manner of things, and how great wonders of the Lord thy God, thou hast seen.
verses.text_hr: Tada mi je anđeo rekao: Idi i reci mojemu narodu kakva si i kako velika čudesa Gospodina, svojega Boga, vidio.
